speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress. To begin my assessment, how long has this breathing difficulty been present?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) due to prematurity at 33 weeks gestation. The onset of distress within two hours of birth in a preterm infant is classic for surfactant deficiency. I recommend immediate confirmation with a Blood_Gas_Analysis and a Chest_X-Ray to assess lung compliance and radiographic findings.
